items.name: Builder Bite
items.info: A hearty bite that makes your Builders work <num>x as fast for <time>. Works in the Home Village! Sadly, the Builder’s Apprentice is a vegetarian and won't be boosted!

items.name: Study Soup
items.info: This bubbling broth makes your Laboratory research and Pet House upgrades <num>x as fast for <time>. Works in the Home Village!

items.name: Mighty Morsel
items.info: A mighty meal that boosts Heroes, Pets and Equipment to the maximum level for your Town Hall for the next <battles> battles. Works in the Home Village!

items.name: Power Pancakes
items.info: A hearty meal that boosts Troops, Spells and Siege Machines to the maximum level for your Town Hall for the next <battles> battles. Works in the Home Village!

items.name: Training Treat
items.info: A quick bite that will instantly train all Troops, Spells and Siege Machines for <time> or at most <battles> battles.

items.name: Clan Castle Cake
items.info: A sweet deal! Add free Reinforcements to your Clan Castle for <time>. To enjoy this treat, join a Clan and add Reinforcements at your Clan Castle!
